questions.question: Walk me through your month-end close responsibilities in your Accountant and Accounting Assistant roles, including the journal entries and reconciliations you prepared.
You have experience with payroll processing and payroll tax filings. How did you calculate payroll-related accruals and ensure payroll expenses were recorded in the correct accounting period?
Describe your experience accounting for prepaid expenses, accrued liabilities, unearned revenue, notes payable, and interest payable under the accrual basis of accounting.
What process did you use to reconcile bank and credit-card accounts, investigate discrepancies, and document any adjusting entries?
Please give an example of a financial statement analysis you performed, including the vertical, horizontal, or forecasting methods used and the business insights you identified.

This role involves maintaining the chart of accounts and supporting cost-center reporting. What experience do you have organizing accounts, classifying transactions, or producing reporting by operational category?
What ERP or accounting systems have you used, including QuickBooks and Sage, and how would you approach learning and working in SAP R/3 or S/4HANA FI?
Describe how you have applied US GAAP or FASB Accounting Standards Codification when evaluating an accounting treatment or preparing financial statements.

Your background includes federal and state corporate, sales, and payroll tax compliance. How did you coordinate accounting records and reconciliations to support preparation of forms such as 941, 940, FUTA, SUTA, or corporate tax returns?
Provide an example of using Excel—such as formulas, VLOOKUPs, PivotTables, or data-analysis tools—to reconcile accounting data, analyze trends, or prepare a management report.
